# Bootstrap — Portable Fallback

Use when starting a new project or a substantial greenfield subsystem.

Read `references/project-bootstrap.md`.

## Modes

- **full** — research and explicit decision work when choices matter;
- **fast** — use established stack/requirements and skip low-value research;
- **parallel** — use independent specialists only where scopes are separable;
- **auto** — continue through authorized runnable steps without pausing at arbitrary progress reports.

Modes change effort, not authority.

## Output

A good bootstrap ends with a working, documented, verified foundation—not merely a folder scaffold.
